comparison.objective: Replace shelf-edge tickets while preserving the neighboring ticket and cans; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Record requires opening a sprung clear front while extracting and inserting thin cards. Candidate requires tool seating, retained fine rotation, torque-limited locking and impact-response observation.
comparison.success_condition: Record checks correct ticket identity, seating, front closure and safe can state. Candidate checks stopping behavior and lock retention; response tolerances are incompletely numeric.
comparison.reason: Bimanual stabilization is shared, but thin-card exchange under a spring cover tests a different ability.
